executive_summary.scientific_question: Why did the Stage-14 pre-analysis produce the narrow horizontal MISESERI/refinement corridor, and can that change be explained from the actual project source/data path rather than inferred from visual correlation?
executive_summary.core_finding: The narrow horizontal MISESERI corridor and the resulting native 14,483-underlying-element adaptive mesh are caused by kinematic strain redistribution during Step-2 phase-field damage localization in Layer 2 (Mechanical UEL), which transfers localized displacement gradients into the co-located Layer 3 companion UMAT. The companion UMAT constitutive update itself is purely linear-elastic without damage degradation (d or H does not enter STRESS or DDSDDE), but evaluates extreme localized stress gradients because of the localized kinematic strain field.

source_verified_facts: Companion UMAT in f42_mixed_uel_inf_stress.for (lines 840-938) computes uncoupled linear elastic Hookean stress (EMOD=1.D-11, nu=0.3); d and H do not enter STRESS or DDSDDE.
Layer 1 (Phase UEL), Layer 2 (Mechanical UEL), and Layer 3 (Companion UMAT) share identical node definitions and cyclic connectivity.
Abaqus RemeshingRule was configured with UNIFORM_ERROR, errorTarget=1.0%, h_min=0.001 mm, h_max=0.020 mm on ALL_ELEM.
numerically_verified_facts: In Step 2 (u = 0.0094 - 0.0100 mm), Layer 2 softening concentrates large opening strain gradients along the y=0.50 mm symmetry ligament.

Companion stress gradients along the ligament shift the corridor error share from 34.98% at u=0.0050 mm to 86.70% at u=0.0094 mm and 95.40% at u=0.0100 mm, while far-field error collapses from 50.87% to 0.07%.
Abaqus adaptiveRemesh produces a 14,483-underlying-element mesh (14,082 quads, 401 triangles) with corridor width w = 0.08 - 0.23 mm.
Deterministic 3-layer reconstruction preserves 100% node coordinate and element topology parity (43,449 layered finite elements).
unresolved_internal_abaqus_details: Abaqus proprietary internal mesh sizing interpolation and patch-recovery smoothing heuristics within the native adaptiveRemesh engine.

executive_summary.safe_miseseri_definition: MISESERI is the Abaqus Mises stress discretization/error indicator associated with the recovered stress solution.

conclusions.reconciliation_of_p90_invariance: P90 was a pure linear-elastic continuum calculation where doubling displacement simply scaled all stresses linearly by 2.0 without altering the normalized error distribution. In Stage 14, mechanical fracture softening broke scale-invariance and localized displacement gradients into the ligament.
conclusions.proof_of_uncoupling: Source inspection of f42_mixed_uel_inf_stress.for confirms that phase field d is not multiplied into companion STRESS or DDSDDE. The localization is kinematic (strain-driven), not a direct constitutive coupling.
conclusions.verdict_statement: The Stage-14 localization transition is fully explained by physical differences between linear-elastic pre-peak loading (Step 1 / P90) and post-damage kinematic strain localization (Step 2 / Stage 14), with verified provenance from PK_M1_JOB1_INF_COMPANION_2906.odb.
